notes.title: Simple Video Merger released
notes.content:
Simple Video Merger joins multiple videos together. Take some videos recorded on the same device and merge them into the single one. No setup, no options, no animation, just one video after another with a few mouse clicks! Few minutes of processing for a multiple hours of video. Fast and Simple.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2293350/Simple_Video_Merger/

notes.title: One Manga Day in Polish
notes.content:
One Manga Day is now available in the Polish language! Great thanks to Steam user damianklu! If you want this game in your language - you can translate it by yourself since the game is open source.

Also, there are some animations and graphics fixes. Thanks anyone for your feedback.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/365070?l=polish

notes.content:
